# 10th Anniversary

Heriot-Watt University Malaysia (HWUM) is celebrating a decade of creating positive impact in Malaysia.

## Be Positive

Join us as we celebrate our 10th anniversary on our beautiful green campus in Putrajaya and reflect on a decade of continual creation of positive impact in Malaysia, one that goes beyond quality education.

### 2022: WATTaDECADE

10 years of impact in Malaysia.

![Image 3](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/first-pro-chancellor-installation-640x36.x2ce94689.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

Installation of our first Pro-Chancellor, Tan Sri Dr Jemilah Mahmood.

![Image 4](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/datuk-yasmin-mahmood.x5ad78b37.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

Appointment of Datuk Yasmin Mahmood as HWUM first Woman Chair on the Board of Directors.

![Image 5](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/professor-tan-sri-dr-jemilah-mahmood-pro-chancellor.xf61ad22d.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2021: First Pro-Chancellor appointed

Appointment of Tan Sri Dr Jemilah Mahmood as HWUM's first Pro-Chancellor.

![Image 6](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/james-watt-fireworks.x62e1c3cf.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2021: University Bicentennial celebrations

Celebration of the Bicentennial of Heriot-Watt University's founding.

![Image 7](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/class-of-2020-your-virtual-celebration.x81a5b3cc.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2020: Virtual Graduation ceremony

First virtual Graduation ceremony by Heriot-Watt University.

![Image 8](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/strategy-2025-launch.x19cb3817.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

Launch of Strategy 2025 on Campus.

First-ever inter-campus dragon boat race at the Putrajaya Water Sport Complex with 40 students from three campuses (UK, Dubai and Malaysia) in Malaysia.

Winner of BrandLaureate's 'Most Iconic Brand' Award.

Celebrated 2018 International University of The Year by The Times and The Sunday Times Good University Guide with former Malaysia's Minister of Higher Education, Dato' Seri Idris Jusoh and the UK's Director for the Department for International Trade and Investment in Malaysia, Ms Debbie Clarke.

Celebrated 5th Anniversary and bid farewell to our founding Provost Professor Bob Craik

![Image 15](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/wheest-room.xe9dbee63.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

Launch of Wheesht (Silent Study Room)

First batch of undergraduate students on our new campus. Malaysia's very first green campus.

Title: Our students won the first and third place of "2021 College Journalism Award" by China Daily

URL Source: https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/2022/0127/c6915a460125/page.htm

Markdown Content:
![Image 1](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/head1_1.gif)

![Image 2](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/head.jpg)
[About](link_0)[Faculty](link_1)[Education](link_2)[News](link_3)[Research](link_4)[International Relations](link_5)[Student Activities](link_6)

![Image 3](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/head1_2.jpg)

Our students won the first and third place of "2021 College Journalism Award" by China Daily time： 2021-12-12

On December 9, the 10th anniversary of the University Journalism Awards and 2021 University Journalism Awards ceremony was held in Hong Kong. Our school of Journalism and Communication's two works robbing Peter to pay Paul: Their future trapped in online small loans and Migrant Workers' Self-defense counter-attack -- douban Stingy Women's Union group research respectively won the champion of Best Economic News Report and the third prize of Best New Media Report. ![Image 4](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/article/images/07/15/cd7705f042d6b41287d259632e2d/816b9a4e-1875-43b8-b550-972590163515.png) Award List Founded in 2012, The China Daily College Journalism Award (formerly known as Campus Journal Journalism Award) is held annually to encourage college students to actively participate in campus news reporting and exercise their news writing skills as well as multimedia production and application abilities. It is the only interactive platform for students in mainland China, Taiwan and four regions to communicate and interact with each other. A total of 54 universities, including Tsinghua University, Fudan University, Renmin University, Nanjing University, South China University of Technology, Chinese University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong Baptist University, University of Macau, Fu Jen University in Taiwan and Shixin University in Taiwan, submitted 770 entries in Both Chinese and English, and 76 of them won prizes.74 political, business and media elites from Taiwan, Taiwan and other Parts of Asia acted as judges to award the first and second runners-up in 24 awards, including Best Campus News Report, Best News Writing, Best News Feature and Best News Photo. Lam Cheng Yuet-Ngor, Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, pre-recorded a video message for the award ceremony. She said the selection has faced some challenges due to the COVID-19 pandemic. However, the organizer made great efforts to overcome various difficulties and successfully held the event, providing a unique interactive platform for media students from Taiwan, Taiwan and four places, which deserves recognition. ![Image 5](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/article/images/07/15/cd7705f042d6b41287d259632e2d/d43006b7-8eb7-4905-b2ce-7b1632f8ba3c.jpg) Video message from Mrs. Carrie Lam, Chief Executive of HKSAR In speech, Chief Secretary for Administration Of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Li Jiachao mentioned three rare aspects of the ceremony: first, the stabilization of the epidemic in Hong Kong has enabled the event to be held offline and life has gradually returned to normal;Second, China Daily has been holding the Journalism Awards for the past 10 years without interruption of the epidemic.Third, the award-winning students care about the society, have a broad vision, have a keen sense of news judgment, are rare news media fresh force. ![Image 6](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/article/images/07/15/cd7705f042d6b41287d259632e2d/1d9ea8a3-d22a-4fdb-99ae-d0d229b6a7ce.jpg) Speech by Mr. Lee Ka Chiu, Chief Secretary for Administration of HKSAR The students said that they were very honored to receive the award. Thanks for the guidance of the teachers from the proposal to the publication of nearly two months, and they are still helping us to revise every word when the deadline is approaching.Professor Zheng Yudan said that the school has always adhered to the concept of journalists focusing on issues and keeping watch over society. Each of the entries in this competition was excellent. Although some of the entries were not awarded, they were rewarded with their best efforts. The School of Journalism and Communication combines talent training with social practice and discipline competitions, roots the ideal of journalism in the earth, and insists on promoting education through competitions, which well cultivates students' vision of journalism and national feelings, and undertakes the mission of contributing to the country and the society. # Maps and directions

![Image 1: An entrance sign for Heriot-Watt University with a bus driving in the background.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/hw-sign-and-bus.x662588f3.jpg?w=1920&h=672&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

Our Edinburgh campus is conveniently located just six miles from Edinburgh city centre

It's easy to reach our campus by car and public transport, whether you're travelling from elsewhere in Scotland or further afield.

## Travelling by plane

[Edinburgh Airport](link_2) is a large international airport with direct flights to many cities including London, Belfast and Birmingham. The easiest way to get to our Edinburgh campus from the airport is by taxi or Uber which takes around 10 minutes. You could also catch a bus or tram from the airport, alight at Haymarket station and get the 25 Lothian bus from Dalry Road directly to campus. This bus takes around 30 minutes and runs every 10 minutes during the day and every 15 minutes after 8pm.

## Travelling by train

[Edinburgh Waverley](link_3) is Edinburgh's main train station located in the city centre, with direct trains to many Scottish and English cities. Many journeys will also stop at Haymarket station which is located at the edge of the city centre (closer to campus). The easiest way to get to campus is to hop on the 25 Lothian bus from Princes St (Stop PP) which takes around 30 minutes.

## Travelling by bus or coach

### Bus

A number of Lothian Bus routes service the Edinburgh campus to and from the city centre every 10 minutes during the day and every 15 minutes after 8pm. The journey will take you 30-40 minutes. In Scotland [under 22s can apply for free bus travel with the Young Persons' Free Bus Travel Scheme](link_4).

### Coach

All National Express coaches arrive at [Edinburgh Bus Station](link_5) located in the heart of the city centre. This is an affordable way to travel and the option of some overnight services.

## Travelling by car

Our Edinburgh Campus is easy to access by car from the centre of Edinburgh and from all major routes leading to the city. The University is half a mile from the Calder Junction off the A720 City of Edinburgh by-pass and the A71, and you'll see signs for Heriot-Watt University on your approach.

*   **Students** can park in car parks A, B, G, H or J
*   **Visitors** to the University should use car park A, B, H or J
*   **Disabled visitors** can use the accessible car park at Gait 10 next to the Centre for Sport & Exercise

A number of electric vehicle charging stations can be found on the Edinburgh campus, for which an RFID card is required to initiate the charge. [You can find the location of the car parks or electric charging stations on the map of Edinburgh Campus](link_6). Visitor parking is free and additional accessible parking spaces are available throughout the campus; you can contact us to reserve one.

### Car Parking

[Parking on the Campus](link_7) is entirely at your own risk and the University accepts no liability or responsibility for any damage caused to vehicles.

Parking on Campus is overseen by the SafeGuarding Team, this includes issuing permits and maintenance of related records.

It is important to note that the parking rules on Campus are as per the Highway Code e.g., not parking on double yellow lines. If you park outside of any of the designated car parks your vehicle may be stickered, if you have a permit, you may be contacted, and in some circumstances your vehicle may be towed away.

If you rely on a blue badge to park your vehicle, you must display this on your vehicle at all times.

If you have any questions or queries about car parking, please contact the car parking team at [carparking@hw.ac.uk](mailto:carparking@hw.ac.uk).

## Travelling by bike

There are several safe cycle routes for commuting to campus

*   [Route from city centre](link_8)
*   [Route from Edinburgh Park](link_9)

About ![Image 4](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Overview](link_4) ![Image 5](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Leadership](link_5) ![Image 6](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Campus](link_6) ![Image 7](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Contact us](link_7)[homepage](link_8)[About](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/6886/list.htm)[Overview](link_4) ![Image 8](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom2.gif)Overview The School of Journalism and Communication at South China University of Technology was established in July 2004. It currently has 69 faculty and staff members, including 48 full-time teachers and 20 professors (11 of whom are doctoral supervisors). There are also 9 postdoctoral researchers. Leveraging its increasingly strong disciplinary foundation, the school has gradually formed a highly capable teaching and research team in journalism and communication. Many of its faculty members are national-level talents, leading talents of the Guangdong Pearl River Talent Program, young talents of the Guangdong Special Support Program, young innovative talents of the State Administration of Radio and Television, and university-level talents, demonstrating a strong faculty. The school offers doctoral degrees in Journalism and Communication (a first-level discipline), a postdoctoral research station in Journalism and Communication, master's degrees in Journalism and Communication (a first-level discipline), and a professional master's degree in Journalism and Communication. Focusing on three enrollment directions—Journalism, Communication, and Computational Advertising and Brand Communication—the School of Journalism and Communication at South China University of Technology has established a multi-level integrated talent training system for journalism and communication, encompassing undergraduate, master's, doctoral, and postdoctoral levels. In the "2024 Shanghai Ranking's Best Chinese Disciplines Ranking," the school's Journalism and Communication discipline ranked 14th nationally, placing it within the top 12%. Guided by Marxist journalism theory and oriented towards serving China's modernization and major national strategic needs, the college integrates and leverages the multidisciplinary advantages of South China University of Technology, which is known for its strengths in science and engineering. It actively explores the construction of "new liberal arts" in journalism and communication, steadily promotes talent cultivation and interdisciplinary integration, and is committed to creating distinctive and advantageous research directions and fields. It focuses on developing two directions: intelligent communication, and cross-cultural communication and new media, and strives to build five research areas: integrated journalism, computational communication, computational advertising, health communication, and international communication. The college comprises four departments and two centers: the Department of Journalism and Communication, the Department of Brand Communication, the Department of Audiovisual Communication, the Department of Internet Communication, the Experimental Teaching Center, and the Humanities Education Center. It boasts two national-level first-class undergraduate programs: Communication Studies (Internet and New Media, Audiovisual Communication) and Advertising (Brand Communication), as well as a Guangdong provincial-level first-class undergraduate program in Journalism. It also offers a "2+2" dual-degree program in Communication Studies (jointly with the University of Missouri's School of Journalism). The college has four national-level first-class undergraduate courses, nine provincial-level first-class undergraduate courses, and one provincial-level demonstration team for curriculum-based ideological and political education reform. In the "2024 Shanghai Ranking's Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU)", the college's Journalism program ranked 12th nationally, while its Communication Studies and Advertising programs both ranked 9th nationally. The existing teaching and experimental equipment is valued at 10 million yuan, with 19,490 books and materials, and 4,063 square meters of administrative and experimental space. It includes the Journalism and Communication Experimental Teaching Demonstration Center (one of the seven sub-centers under the National Humanities Comprehensive Experimental Teaching Demonstration Center, including a converged media laboratory, a photography and videography laboratory, a motion capture mixed reality laboratory, and a live streaming laboratory). The college boasts a joint-construction base—the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area International Communication Research Institute; three provincial and ministerial-level key laboratories (research centers)—the Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of New Media and Brand Communication Innovation Application (the first provincial key laboratory in Guangdong's journalism and communication discipline), the Guangdong Provincial Engineering Technology Research Center for Big Data and Computational Advertising, and the Guangdong Provincial Center for Public Health Risk Monitoring and Information Dissemination; a Guangdong Provincial characteristic new-type think tank—the Research Center for Digital and Intelligent Precision International Communication; a national first-level academic society (China Higher Education Film and Television Society) research platform—the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Network Audiovisual Creation and Research Center; a Guangdong Provincial Higher Education Philosophy and Social Science Innovation Team—the Interdisciplinary Research Team for Computational Communication; and university-level research platforms such as the Data Analysis and Information Visualization Research Center, the Network Public Opinion Research Center, the Documentary Creation and Research Center, the Institute of Social Computing, and the Hakka Culture Research Center. The college has seized the major historical opportunity of the national development of new liberal arts and the prosperity of philosophy and social sciences. In recent years, it has achieved outstanding research results. In the past five years, it has been approved for 2 major projects, 3 key projects, 1 key project of post-funding, 10 general projects and 4 youth projects of the National Social Science Fund; published more than 300 papers in CSSCI, SCI and SSCI; won 1 "Youth Achievement Award" of the Outstanding Scientific Research Achievement Award of Higher Education Institutions of the Ministry of Education; and won 2 first prizes, 2 second prizes and 2 third prizes of Guangdong Provincial Social Science Award. Leveraging Guangzhou's geographical advantages and the industry strengths of South China's news and media sector, the college provides students with abundant practical and employment opportunities. Graduates are primarily employed by mainstream central and local media outlets, internet companies, Fortune Global 500 and China 500 companies, government agencies, and public institutions. The college has cultivated a group of high-caliber journalism and communication professionals renowned for their solid fundamentals, broad knowledge, and strong practical abilities.

## Our campuses

Our campuses in Edinburgh, Scottish Borders, Orkney, Dubai and Malaysia offer bespoke facilities and a distinctive learning environment.

[![Image 12](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/edinburgh-castle.xc283e5fa.jpg?crop=5060%2C2584%2C983%2C825&w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Edinburgh Set in 380 acres of beautiful parkland, opt to study at our Edinburgh Campus and you’ll find a wide variety of programmes and specialist facilities designed to help you reach your full potential.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/edinburgh [link_10])[![Image 13](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/orkney-islands-1-rphstock-shutterstock.x648d8b8c.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Orkney Heriot-Watt Orkney is one of the UK’s most stunning and unique university locations. For over 25 years the campus has supported a broad range of research, teaching and consultancy activities.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/orkney [link_11])[![Image 14](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/unknown.xd3090854.jpeg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Scottish Borders A countryside location, situated at the heart of Scotland's textile industry, Heriot-Watt's Scottish Borders campus provides access to specialist facilities and production equipment for textiles, fashion and design.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/scottish-borders [link_12])[![Image 15](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/news-articles/heriot-watt-dubai-campus.x93c6045e.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Dubai Heriot-Watt University Dubai offers an extensive range of research-informed degree programmes in a global study environment, with strong links to business and industry.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai [link_13])[![Image 16](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/studentLifeBanners/Life-in-Campus/Malaysia.x746a97d5.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Malaysia Heriot-Watt Malaysia University offers high quality British education with a range of courses and global study opportunities at our modern campus in Putrajaya.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/malaysia [link_14])[![Image 17](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/HWO-Apply.x3a89d472.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Heriot-Watt Online Heriot-Watt University offers a unique online learning experience that enables you to study flexibly online. # Study at Heriot-Watt University Malaysia

This carousel automatically advances through 1 slides. Use the pause button to stop the automatic rotation.

![Image 1: Aerial view of Heriot-Watt Malaysia campus](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/news-articles/malaysia.x4734dc90.jpg?w=1280&h=474&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

FutureMade since 1821

Heriot-Watt University Malaysia offers high-quality British education and global study at our modern campus in Putrajaya.

[Browse our programmes](https://www.hw.ac.uk/search/programmes?f.Location=Malaysia&f.Location=Online)

## Search our programmes

Search our programmes Level- [x] Foundation - [x] Undergraduate - [x] Postgraduate - [x] Research - [x] Graduate Apprenticeships Search

## Study at our Malaysia Campus

We offer a range of programmes at foundation, undergraduate and postgraduate level.

[![Image 2](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/ci-malaysia-foundation.xf4188fd6.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Foundation Our Foundation Programme offers tailored pathways, in Science or Business, to our undergraduate degree programmes.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/malaysia/study/foundation)[![Image 3](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/ci-malaysia-undergraduate.x60f4e119.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Undergraduate Our career-focused degrees include business, finance, built environment and engineering specialisms.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/malaysia/search/programmes?f.Level=Undergraduate)[![Image 4](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/ci-malaysia-postgraduate.x0d9e5e8f.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Postgraduate Our professionally relevant Masters and PhD opportunities are designed to meet the demands and economic drivers of the world today.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/malaysia/search/programmes?f.Level=Postgraduate&f.Level=Research&f.Location=Malaysia&f.Location=Online)

## We are ranked 32nd of UK universities

(QS World University Rankings 2024)

## Visit our Open Day

Discover excellence at our Open Day!

Explore our campus with cutting-edge facilities, from advanced labs to modern lecture halls. Experience an environment that fosters innovation, empowering students to reach their potential.

[Join us](https://www.hw.ac.uk/malaysia/campus/open-days)

## Chat with an Education Consultant

We believe in empowering students to create positive impact through education that is driven by purpose.

Chat with us and learn more about our purpose-driven programmes, scholarships, waivers and seamless transfer to the UK and Dubai campuses today!

[Get in touch](https://www.hw.ac.uk/malaysia/visit/chat-with-an-education-consultant)

## £35 million

### £35 million was invested in our Malaysia campus, which is the first 'green campus' in the country.

## Why choose Heriot-Watt?

One of the most progressive and international institutions based in Scotland,you will have the opportunity to thrive, both personally and academically during your time with us.

[![Image 5](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/purpose-driven-education.x3d67b8e8.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Purpose-Driven Education Our commitment to Purpose-Driven Education does not only focus on academic excellence but also the holistic development of individuals.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/malaysia/about/purpose-driven-education)[![Image 6](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/malaysia-about-us-banner.x97d0ad4b.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### About us Our first Malaysian student graduated from our Edinburgh campus in 1967. In 2014, we opened our first Malaysian campus.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/malaysia/about)[![Image 7](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/ci-malaysia-meet-our-students.x18b5a114.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Meet our students Find out what our students have to say about campus life here and the advice they would offer students considering Heriot-Watt University Malaysia.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/malaysia/study/meet-our-students)[![Image 8](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/programme-brochures.xab477ef4.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Our publications Heriot-Watt University Malaysia Global College, Undergraduate and Postgraduate brochures.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/malaysia/about/our-publications)

## Latest news

All the exciting news from across the Heriot-Watt Malaysia Campus

[See more](https://www.hw.ac.uk/malaysia/search/news)

[![Image 9](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/news-articles/professor-nola-hewitt-dundas-principal-and-vice-chancellor-of-heriot-watt-university.x30bf20d9.JPG?crop=6000%2C3599%2C0%2C0&w=500&h=300&fit=crop&q=90&f=webp) News ### New Principal and Vice-Chancellor takes up post at Heriot-Watt University Heriot-Watt University welcomes Professor Nola Hewitt-Dundas as its new Principal and Vice-Chancellor. Share your experiences of life at Heriot-Watt

# Study at Heriot-Watt University Dubai

This carousel automatically advances through 4 slides. Use the pause button to stop the automatic rotation.

![Image 1: Three students are in library, actively discussing and working with laptop](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/students-international-dubai-studying.x871805c4.png?w=1280&h=474&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

January intake is now open

Start this January with a wider choice of programmes than ever before and a supportive learning environment designed to prepare you for the future.

[Start your journey](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/study/apply/january-intake)

![Image 2: Individual helping a student from across a computer desk](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/dubai-student-services.xd1e7cfd4.JPG?w=1280&h=474&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

Enrol today. Classes start soon.

Take the next step towards your future by joining a globally recognised university this September

[Enrol into your courses](https://www.hw.ac.uk/students/new-students/dubai-campus-students)

![Image 3: Graduates in caps and gowns, capturing the joy of their graduation moment together](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/graduation-student.x238a1e70.jpg?w=1280&h=474&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

Congratulations on your high school results

We are here to help you take the next step and guide you through your educational journey.

[Learn more](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/study/apply/high-school-results)

![Image 4: Angular view of the Heriot-Watt University building featuring its logo and surrounded by greenery](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/0g5a0996.xbf2accc4.jpg?w=1280&h=474&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

Virtual campus tour

The Dubai campus is designed with students at its heart, featuring modern facilities and spaces created to elevate the student experience.

[360 tour](https://exploredubai.hw.ac.uk/)

1 / 4

## Search our programmes

Search our programmes Level- [x] Foundation - [x] Undergraduate - [x] Postgraduate - [x] Research - [x] Graduate Apprenticeships Search

## Start your degree this January

Start this January with a wider choice of programmes than ever before and a supportive learning environment designed to prepare you for the future.

[See more](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/study/apply/january-intake)

## Study at our Dubai Campus

We offer a range of programmes at degree entry, undergraduate and postgraduate level.

[![Image 5](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/1102594094.xa6a648e9.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Foundation](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/study/foundation)[![Image 6](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/programmeBanners/dubai/interior-dubai-students-talking-Cropped-2453x1635.x88c7c123.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Undergraduate study](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/search/programmes?f.Level=Undergraduate)[![Image 7](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/dru-9138.x4e324335.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Postgraduate study](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/search/programmes?f.Level=Postgraduate)[![Image 8](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/w7a62731.x1cb53b83.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### PhD study](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/search/programmes?f.Level=Research)

## MoHESR accredited

Our undergraduate and postgraduate programmes are accredited by the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research in the UAE.

## 88.9% of our graduates achieve a positive employment or further study outcome within 12 months of graduating with 66% securing this within 3 months.

Graduate Destination Survey 2024, UAE Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MoHESR)

[![Image 9](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/events/web-banner1.xa7c30738.png?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Our rankings From the quality of our teaching to student satisfaction and graduate employability, Heriot-Watt University is consistently ranked at a high level across a number of key university league tables.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/study/our-rankings)[![Image 10](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/programmeBanners/dubai/exterior-dubai-students-Cropped-2536x1690.x1822f990.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Go Global As a global university, Heriot-Watt offers inter-campus transfers and the chance to experience our UK and Malaysia campuses.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/study/go-global)[![Image 11](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/dubai-meet-our-students-banner.x25c11cf8.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Meet our students Find out what some of our current students have to say about student life at Heriot-Watt University's Dubai Campus.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/study/meet-our-students)

> We are ranked 1st in Scotland for producing the highest percentage of CEOs and Managing Directors.

Novuna Business Cash Flow, 2025

## State-of-the-art campus

The Dubai campus is designed with student learning and wellbeing at its heart, featuring a wide range of modern facilities and collaborative spaces designed to elevate the student experience.

[![Image 12](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/studentLifeBanners/Life-in-Campus/Dubai.x063438f0.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### The Dubai Campus Heriot-Watt University, Dubai's state-of-the-art campus in Knowledge Park opened in April 2021](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/campus/the-dubai-campus)[![Image 13](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/dubai-james-watt-building-front.xab52d5a2.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### The James Watt Building Discover the James Watt Building at Heriot‑Watt University Dubai, a modern teaching and learning space featuring lecture theatres, study areas and facilities that support student life on the Dubai campus.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/campus/the-dubai-campus/james-watt-building)[![Image 14](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/dubaiburjkhalifa-rdax.x9405cdcc.png?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Studying in Dubai Find out why to study in Heriot-Watt University in Dubai. Dubai is a global centre for innovation, technology, sustainability and business, which makes it an excellent place to study as a student.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/study/go-global/studying-in-dubai)[![Image 15](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/student-accommodation.x20c9d1c8.png?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Student accommodation Explore our various accommodation options tailored to fit your needs, including hotels and traditional residences.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/campus/student-accommodation)

## Virtual Tour

Walk through our campus virtually and get a feel for the places where you will learn, connect, and grow.

[View 360](https://exploredubai.hw.ac.uk/)

> The entire learning experience was remarkable, but the highlight must be all the site visits organised as part of the course structure. The exposure received during these visits helped put the theory taught in class into perspective.

Inas Kamel, BEng (Hons) Civil Engineering graduate

## Meet our students

[Read more](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/study/meet-our-students)

[![Image 16](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/profiles/students/inaskameledit.xe0973ff0.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Inas Kamel BEng (Hons) Civil Engineering graduate](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/study/meet-our-students/inas-kamel)[![Image 17](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/profiles/students/josephleander.x28cc6e56.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Joseph Leander BA (Hons) Architecture graduate](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/study/meet-our-students/joseph-leander)[![Image 18](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/profiles/students/saya.x7fd72e2e.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Zhansaya Kussainova BA Fashion graduate](https://www.hw.ac.uk/dubai/study/meet-our-students/zhansaya-kussainova)

## Latest news

All the exciting news from across the Dubai Campus

# Campuses

Our Scottish campuses offer an extensive range of research-informed degree programmes in a global study environment with strong links to business and industry.

## Campus locations

Our campuses in Edinburgh, Scottish Borders and Orkney each offer bespoke facilities and a distinctive learning environment.

[![Image 2](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/bi-edinburgh-campus.x6770e3b7.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Edinburgh A beautiful parkland campus with world class facilities in a city that's renowned for art, culture and learning.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/edinburgh)[![Image 3](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/unknown.xd3090854.jpeg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Scottish Borders Industry standard facilities, perfectly located in Galashiels in the heart of the Scottish luxury textiles industry.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/scottish-borders)[![Image 4](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/orkney-ruins-skara-brae.x79d00a10.png?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Orkney A unique 'living laboratory' campus that makes full use of its impressive natural surroundings.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/orkney)

## Exchange programme

There are great benefits to taking part in a student exchange programme. You can visit a new country, meet new people, experience a new way of life and graduates with international experience are actively sought by employers. Find out more about our exchange programmes, whether you are eligible and what countries and partner institutions are involved.

[![Image 5](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/leith-shore-banner-2000x1333.xb79daa2d.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### European exchange We have European exchange agreements with a number of institutions around Europe.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/exchange-programme/european-exchange)[![Image 6](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/malaysia-campus-students-banner-2000x1333.xd0829ab6.png?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Worldwide exchange The Exchange programme enables you to study outside of Europe as part of your degree programme, usually for a full academic year.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/exchange-programme/worldwide-exchange)[![Image 7](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/blogs/hw-shield.x6bd63017.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Turing scheme The Turing Scheme is the the UK Government's replacement to Erasmus+ and can support you on placements all over the world.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/exchange-programme/turing-scheme)[![Image 8](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/dubai-students-banner.xd5cd87a8.png?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Go Global Study abroad with our inter-campus transfer programme, Go Global. Choose to study at a Heriot-Watt campus abroad for a semester, a year, or even longer.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/go-global)

### 1st

We are ranked 1st in Scotland and 3rd in the UK for the amount spent on student facilities. (The Complete University Guide 2027).

### 1/3

Around a third of our on-campus students studying in Scotland are from outside of the UK.

## Accommodation

Our student accommodation is tailored to students' needs and priorities as well as providing space for you to meet and socialise.

[![Image 9](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/edinburgh-accommodation-banner.x7e3ee881.png?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Edinburgh Accommodation Our student accommodation is conveniently located within easy reach of our extensive campus facilities.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/edinburgh/accommodation)[![Image 10](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/HWU-6728.x863d8e44.png?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Scottish Borders Accommodation The newly-designed Jean Muir Student Village offers large bedrooms, modern facilities and plenty of space for you to study and socialise in.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/scottish-borders/accommodation)[![Image 11](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/bi-open-day-students.xd7b9cd9c.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Open Days The best way to experience our unique campus environment is to visit in person at one of our Open Days.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/visit-us/undergraduate-open-days)[![Image 12](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/ph-james-watt-statue.x6d9514bb.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Campus tours Explore our campuses by booking a guided tour of the living and study facilities we offer.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/visit-us/campus-tours)

## Latest news

Check out the latest news from across our UK campuses

[See more](https://www.hw.ac.uk/search/news)

[![Image 13](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/news-articles/all-winners-group-photo.x47a40d8d.jpg?w=500&h=300&fit=crop&q=90&f=webp) News ### Health and care innovators secure four prizes at Converge 2026 Heriot-Watt ventures TissueMetrics and RecoverPX secure four prizes and £80,000 in funding at the Converge Awards 2026. Date 2 Oct 2026](https://www.hw.ac.uk/news/2026/heriot-watt-innovators-secure-four-prizes-at-converge-2026)[![Image 14](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/news-articles/panmure-house.x69e5d086.jpg?w=500&h=300&fit=crop&q=90&f=webp) News ### World-leading experts to debate climate inaction in Edinburgh finance event Two leading climate finance experts will debate why the world continues to fall short on climate action at Heriot-Watt University’s Panmure House. Date 2 Oct 2026](https://www.hw.ac.uk/news/2026/world-leading-experts-to-debate-climate-inaction-in-edinburgh-finance-event)[![Image 15](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/news-articles/mercedes-peter-news-image-2.x52f5cc4c.jpg?w=500&h=300&fit=crop&q=90&f=webp) News ### Two Heriot-Watt academics elected Fellows of the Royal Academy of Engineering Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer OBE FRSE and Professor Peter Cummings of Heriot-Watt University have been elected Fellows of the Royal Academy of Engineering. Date 24 Sept 2026](https://www.hw.ac.uk/news/2026/two-heriot-watt-academics-elected-fellows-of-the-royal-academy-of-engineering)

# Edinburgh Campus

Set in 380 acres of beautiful parkland, opt to study at our Edinburgh Campus and you'll find a wide variety of programmes and specialist facilities designed to help you reach your full potential.

## Study in Edinburgh

Green and peaceful with ample space to think, play and enjoy, our Edinburgh campus is an exceptional environment within easy reach of one of Europe's most exciting cities.

### [Explore Edinburgh programmes Our Edinburgh Campus is truly international. Over 10,500 staff and students are based here, with around a third of them coming from outside the UK. Our international students find a warm and friendly welcome and all the support they might need.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/search/programmes?f.Location=Edinburgh)### [Heriot-Watt Student Union There's more to university life than simply getting your degree, and Heriot-Watt University Student Union is all about helping you to have the best possible experience while you study here.](https://www.hwunion.com/)

[![Image 2](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/ci-clubs-and-activities.x3d0e9c10.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Clubs and activities Our Students' Association is very active and plays a key role in bringing students together](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/edinburgh/clubs-activities)[![Image 3](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/ci-facilities.x21c14574.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Facilities At Heriot-Watt University, we offer a wide range of services to help you deal with all aspects of your life with us.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/edinburgh/facilities)[![Image 4](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/ci-edinburgh-campus-accommodation.x9918c742.jpg?w=640&h=480&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp) ### Accommodation at Edinburgh Campus We have 2000 rooms of student accommodation in self-catering halls of residences on campus at Heriot-Watt University's Edinburgh Campus.](https://www.hw.ac.uk/campuses/edinburgh/accommodation)

## Explore the Edinburgh campus

Green and peaceful with ample space to think, play and enjoy, take a tour of the Edinburgh campus.

[Start Tour](https://explore.hw.ac.uk/explore/life-in-edinburgh-2?study_level=not-sure&subject_area=not-sure&locale=ruk)

## A festival city

Edinburgh is a really lively city with plenty to see and do. It's a great city for cultural events with something happening every day of the week.

Whether it's music, film, theatre, comedy or the arts, you're bound to find plenty going on of interest.

Home to the Edinburgh International Festival and the Edinburgh Festival Fringe, the city is a focal point for art, culture, comedy and drama. From medieval lanes to modern architecture, museums to nightlife, there is plenty to do when you choose to study at Heriot-Watt University, Edinburgh.

## Work and play

Exceptional teaching facilities and our close links with industry make our Heriot-Watt Edinburgh Campus a fulfilling and stimulating study environment. Our new GRID facility is designed to be a space where students can learn, tackle and immerse their curiosity and intellectual passions, while our £7m purpose-built Postgraduate Centre is a hub for advanced learning and research.

Heriot-Watt University Edinburgh is home to Scotland's new £33m national Sports Performance Centre, Oriam. With access to these fantastic facilities, as well as, a wide range of clubs and societies, you will be sure to find people to share your interests with.

[Explore Oriam](https://oriamscotland.com/)

# About

## Our established reputation

With a history dating back to 1821, we have a long tradition of excellence and a proven track record in educating, inspiring and challenging the professionals of tomorrow. We are one of the top UK universities for business and industry and have an established reputation for world-class teaching and practical, leading-edge research.

### Top rankings

The University and our programmes are in the top rankings in the UK and globally.

*   Heriot-Watt is ranked 1st in the UK for **Building**, 5th in the UK for **Mathematics**, and 1st in Scotland for **Aeronautical & Manufacturing Engineering**, **Mechanical Engineering** and **Building**- The Times and The Sunday Times Good University Guide 2026
*   36th in UK and 325th in the World - QS World University Rankings 2027
*   2nd in the UK and 1st in Scotland for **Chemical Engineering**. Top 3 in Scotland for **Chemistry**, **Civil Engineering**, **Economics**, **Fashion and Textiles**, **Interior Design**, **Language and Linguistics**, and **Physics**. - Guardian University Guide 2027
*   86.8% of our research and 88.6% of our research outputs ranked as 'world-leading' or 'internationally excellent' - REF 2021

See more [top rankings](https://www.hw.ac.uk/study/why-study-at-heriot-watt/our-rankings).

### Our high-quality, career-relevant degrees

The degree programmes at Heriot-Watt are career-focused and relevant to the needs of business and industry, leading employers to actively seek out our graduates. We work in partnership with the professions to develop and accredit our degrees, ensuring career-relevant education and an environment that helps to foster the leaders of tomorrow. Our aim is to equip our graduates with the skills to achieve their ambitions and perform at a high level in their careers.

### Our international outlook

For over 20 years we have been committed to providing education of the highest standard to students around the world including:

*   a pioneering distance learning programme, launched in 1990 to allow students worldwide to study a Heriot-Watt University degree
*   our Dubai Campus, opened in 2005, was the first overseas campus in Dubai International Academic City. In 2011 we capitalised on our success by opening the first purpose-built campus
*   Today we have 29,500 students studying our programmes in 143 countries
*   Our future in Malaysia is an exciting one with the recent opening of our new green campus.

Read more [key facts](https://www.hw.ac.uk/about/profile) about Heriot-Watt University.

About ![Image 4](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Overview](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/6887/list.htm "Overview") ![Image 5](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Leadership](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/Leadership/list.htm "Leadership") ![Image 6](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Campus](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/6894/list.htm "Campus") ![Image 7](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Contact us](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/Contactus/list.htm "Contact us")[homepage](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/main.htm)[About](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/6886/list.htm)[Overview](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/6887/list.htm) ![Image 8](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom2.gif)Overview The School of Journalism and Communication at South China University of Technology was established in July 2004. It currently has 69 faculty and staff members, including 48 full-time teachers and 20 professors (11 of whom are doctoral supervisors). There are also 9 postdoctoral researchers. Leveraging its increasingly strong disciplinary foundation, the school has gradually formed a highly capable teaching and research team in journalism and communication. Many of its faculty members are national-level talents, leading talents of the Guangdong Pearl River Talent Program, young talents of the Guangdong Special Support Program, young innovative talents of the State Administration of Radio and Television, and university-level talents, demonstrating a strong faculty. The school offers doctoral degrees in Journalism and Communication (a first-level discipline), a postdoctoral research station in Journalism and Communication, master's degrees in Journalism and Communication (a first-level discipline), and a professional master's degree in Journalism and Communication. Focusing on three enrollment directions—Journalism, Communication, and Computational Advertising and Brand Communication—the School of Journalism and Communication at South China University of Technology has established a multi-level integrated talent training system for journalism and communication, encompassing undergraduate, master's, doctoral, and postdoctoral levels. In the "2024 Shanghai Ranking's Best Chinese Disciplines Ranking," the school's Journalism and Communication discipline ranked 14th nationally, placing it within the top 12%. Guided by Marxist journalism theory and oriented towards serving China's modernization and major national strategic needs, the college integrates and leverages the multidisciplinary advantages of South China University of Technology, which is known for its strengths in science and engineering. It actively explores the construction of "new liberal arts" in journalism and communication, steadily promotes talent cultivation and interdisciplinary integration, and is committed to creating distinctive and advantageous research directions and fields. It focuses on developing two directions: intelligent communication, and cross-cultural communication and new media, and strives to build five research areas: integrated journalism, computational communication, computational advertising, health communication, and international communication. The college comprises four departments and two centers: the Department of Journalism and Communication, the Department of Brand Communication, the Department of Audiovisual Communication, the Department of Internet Communication, the Experimental Teaching Center, and the Humanities Education Center. It boasts two national-level first-class undergraduate programs: Communication Studies (Internet and New Media, Audiovisual Communication) and Advertising (Brand Communication), as well as a Guangdong provincial-level first-class undergraduate program in Journalism. It also offers a "2+2" dual-degree program in Communication Studies (jointly with the University of Missouri's School of Journalism). The college has four national-level first-class undergraduate courses, nine provincial-level first-class undergraduate courses, and one provincial-level demonstration team for curriculum-based ideological and political education reform. In the "2024 Shanghai Ranking's Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU)", the college's Journalism program ranked 12th nationally, while its Communication Studies and Advertising programs both ranked 9th nationally. The existing teaching and experimental equipment is valued at 10 million yuan, with 19,490 books and materials, and 4,063 square meters of administrative and experimental space. It includes the Journalism and Communication Experimental Teaching Demonstration Center (one of the seven sub-centers under the National Humanities Comprehensive Experimental Teaching Demonstration Center, including a converged media laboratory, a photography and videography laboratory, a motion capture mixed reality laboratory, and a live streaming laboratory). The college boasts a joint-construction base—the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area International Communication Research Institute; three provincial and ministerial-level key laboratories (research centers)—the Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of New Media and Brand Communication Innovation Application (the first provincial key laboratory in Guangdong's journalism and communication discipline), the Guangdong Provincial Engineering Technology Research Center for Big Data and Computational Advertising, and the Guangdong Provincial Center for Public Health Risk Monitoring and Information Dissemination; a Guangdong Provincial characteristic new-type think tank—the Research Center for Digital and Intelligent Precision International Communication; a national first-level academic society (China Higher Education Film and Television Society) research platform—the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Network Audiovisual Creation and Research Center; a Guangdong Provincial Higher Education Philosophy and Social Science Innovation Team—the Interdisciplinary Research Team for Computational Communication; and university-level research platforms such as the Data Analysis and Information Visualization Research Center, the Network Public Opinion Research Center, the Documentary Creation and Research Center, the Institute of Social Computing, and the Hakka Culture Research Center. The college has seized the major historical opportunity of the national development of new liberal arts and the prosperity of philosophy and social sciences. In recent years, it has achieved outstanding research results. In the past five years, it has been approved for 2 major projects, 3 key projects, 1 key project of post-funding, 10 general projects and 4 youth projects of the National Social Science Fund; published more than 300 papers in CSSCI, SCI and SSCI; won 1 "Youth Achievement Award" of the Outstanding Scientific Research Achievement Award of Higher Education Institutions of the Ministry of Education; and won 2 first prizes, 2 second prizes and 2 third prizes of Guangdong Provincial Social Science Award. Leveraging Guangzhou's geographical advantages and the industry strengths of South China's news and media sector, the college provides students with abundant practical and employment opportunities. Graduates are primarily employed by mainstream central and local media outlets, internet companies, Fortune Global 500 and China 500 companies, government agencies, and public institutions. The college has cultivated a group of high-caliber journalism and communication professionals renowned for their solid fundamentals, broad knowledge, and strong practical abilities.

Research ![Image 4](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Overview](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/6905/list.htm "Overview") ![Image 5](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Laboratories & Centers](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/6906/list.htm "Laboratories & Centers") ![Image 6](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Research Achievements](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/6907/list.htm "Research Achievements") ![Image 7](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Research Projects](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/6908/list.htm "Research Projects") ![Image 8](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Achievement Transformation](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/6909/list.htm "Achievement Transformation") ![Image 9](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom4.gif)[Academic Exchanges](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/6910/list.htm "Academic Exchanges")[homepage](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/main.htm)[Research](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/6904/list.htm)[Overview](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/sjc_en/6905/list.htm) ![Image 10](https://www2.scut.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/00/f1/241/template241/images/bottom2.gif)Overview **Academic****Overview** In 2021,the School of Journalism and Communication(SJC)ranked top 10% of the best disciplines in China by the Academic Ranking of World Universities. In 2006, the school began to recruit graduate students in communications. In 2011, the school was authorized to offer MPh degree, and in 2014 the school was authorized to offer MA degree. From 2013, it partnered with SCUT’s School of Marxism to offer an interdisciplinary doctoral degree in Marxist Journalism and Communication Research, and the Ph.D. degree application in Journalism and Communication was submitted in 2021. With the cross-integration of Arts, Science, and engineering, SJC highlights its strength in communication theory, data journalism, advertising, health communication, digital culture, etc. SJC is also specialized in the research on communication history, new media, computational communication, audio-visual communication, brand communication, and trans-cultural diffusion. At present, one centre and five platforms have been established, referring to the journalism and Communication sub-centre of the National Experimental Teaching Demonstration Center for liberal arts; the national and regional research and training base of the Ministry of Education, the Key Laboratory of new media and Brand Communication Innovation and application of Guangdong Province, the Guangdong Big Data and Computational Advertising Engineering Technology Center, the Guangdong Public Diplomacy and Trans-cultural diffusion, and the Guangdong Public Health Risk Monitoring and information communication centre, and a number of school-level platforms such as the Centre for Data Analysis and Visualization, the Centre for Documentary Creation and Research, and the Hakka People Institute of Cultural Studies. Two national secondary institutes have been established as the local journalism history research society of the China Journalism History Society, the Documentary Committee of the film and Television Society of China’s Universities, and the Network Audio-visual Creation and Research Center of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Bay Area. SJC achieved the integration of production, education and research, and is influential in academia and industries. In terms of scientific research projects and paper output, in recent five years, our school has undertaken 14 National Social Science Fund projects (including 2 major projects and 2 key projects) and 78 provincial and ministerial-level projects, the total project funding reached 19,781,600 RMB. Won 2 awards of the Ministry of Education Humanities and Social Sciences, 6 awards of the Provincial Social Sciences Achievement. Over 200 papers have been published, including more than 200 CSSCI, 19 SSCI, 5 SCI, among which 4 of Q1 papers. Besides, 57 textbooks and monographs are published in the past 5 years.

# 10th Anniversary

Heriot-Watt University Malaysia (HWUM) is celebrating a decade of creating positive impact in Malaysia.

### How to watch this YouTube video

Accept cookies and watch[Watch on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8W2Amitw7iU)

## Be Positive

Join us as we celebrate our 10th anniversary on our beautiful green campus in Putrajaya and reflect on a decade of continual creation of positive impact in Malaysia, one that goes beyond quality education.

![Image 2](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/malaysia-10-anniversary.x2eeb8715.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2022: WATTaDECADE

10 years of impact in Malaysia.

![Image 3](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/first-pro-chancellor-installation-640x36.x2ce94689.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2022: Installation of first Pro-Chancellor

Installation of our first Pro-Chancellor, Tan Sri Dr Jemilah Mahmood.

![Image 4](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/datuk-yasmin-mahmood.x5ad78b37.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2021: First woman Chair on Board of Directors

Appointment of Datuk Yasmin Mahmood as HWUM first Woman Chair on the Board of Directors.

![Image 5](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/professor-tan-sri-dr-jemilah-mahmood-pro-chancellor.xf61ad22d.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2021: First Pro-Chancellor appointed

Appointment of Tan Sri Dr Jemilah Mahmood as HWUM's first Pro-Chancellor.

![Image 6](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/james-watt-fireworks.x62e1c3cf.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2021: University Bicentennial celebrations

Celebration of the Bicentennial of Heriot-Watt University's founding.

![Image 7](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/class-of-2020-your-virtual-celebration.x81a5b3cc.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2020: Virtual Graduation ceremony

First virtual Graduation ceremony by Heriot-Watt University.

![Image 8](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/strategy-2025-launch.x19cb3817.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2019: Launch of Strategy 2025

Launch of Strategy 2025 on Campus.

![Image 9](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/visit-from-hrh-prince-edward.x40b628d7.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2019: Visit of HRH Prince Edward

Visit of HRH Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex

![Image 10](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/2018-dragon-boat-race.x4e46ba8c.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2018: Dragon boat race

First-ever inter-campus dragon boat race at the Putrajaya Water Sport Complex with 40 students from three campuses (UK, Dubai and Malaysia) in Malaysia.

![Image 11](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/2018-iconic-brand-award.x84c62413.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2018: Most Iconic Brand Award

Winner of BrandLaureate's 'Most Iconic Brand' Award.

![Image 12](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/2017-international-university-of-the-year.x77424fb3.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2017: International University of the Year

Celebrated 2018 International University of The Year by The Times and The Sunday Times Good University Guide with former Malaysia's Minister of Higher Education, Dato' Seri Idris Jusoh and the UK's Director for the Department for International Trade and Investment in Malaysia, Ms Debbie Clarke.

![Image 13](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/2017-first-graduation-ceremony.x66c91d74.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

The first group of undergraduates graduated.

![Image 14](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/2017-fifth-anniversary-celebrations.x0c341d80.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

Celebrated 5th Anniversary and bid farewell to our founding Provost Professor Bob Craik

![Image 15](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/wheest-room.xe9dbee63.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2016: Launch of Wheesht

Launch of Wheesht (Silent Study Room)

![Image 16](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/2015-launch-of-new-campus.x24684eb7.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2015: Official launch of the Campus

Official launch of our new campus by the Minister of Education II, Idris Jusoh and British High Commissioner, Vicky Treadell.

![Image 17](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/go-global-malaysia-shrine.x6ee8859c.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

First batch of Malaysian Go Global students left for UK and first batch of UK Go Global students into Malaysia.

First group of staff on the new campus in Putrajaya

![Image 19](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/2014-first-batch-of-staff-and-students.xdc72a8e5.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2013: First UG students

First batch of undergraduate students on our new campus. Malaysia's very first green campus.

![Image 20](https://www.hw.ac.uk/image-library/2013-first-ug-and-pg-students.x473453c9.jpg?w=720&h=320&fit=crop&q=75&f=webp)

### 2013: First PG students

Heriot Watt University Malaysia's first postgraduate students.

# University of Chicago to celebrate Center in Beijing’s 10th anniversary

By

[Angela Chau](https://www.findworldedu.com/author/gavincheung)

 - 

05/01/2021

**The University of Chicago will celebrate the 10th anniversary of its Center in Beijing with a series of virtual events in January 2021 highlighting the University’s deep history of engagement and research partnerships with China.**

![Image 38](https://www.findworldedu.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/center_in_beijing-1024x576.jpg)

_Prof. Dali Yang (left) greets Nobel laureate Chen Ning Yang, PhD’48, during the 2010 opening of the Center in Beijing. The University will celebrate the center’s 10th anniversary through a monthlong event series in January._

The monthlong program will begin Jan. 5 with the first in a series of twice-weekly discussions featuring UChicago scholars and their Chinese collaborators. The events will culminate in a Jan. 29 celebration that will include a fireside chat between President Robert J. Zimmer and Juan de Pablo, Vice President for National Laboratories, Science Strategy, Innovation and Global Initiatives, reflecting on the challenges and opportunities facing higher education, as well as remarks from Provost Ka Yee C. Lee.

The Center in Beijing was established in 2010 to support the growing number of University of Chicago faculty engaged with collaborators in the region, as well as the increasing number of students and alumni in China. It has served as a hub to enhance and strengthen the University’s rich tradition of engagement in China in many fields of study. Since its opening, the Center has hosted over 500 events, welcomed over 45,000 visitors, and served over 2,500 faculty, staff and students.

“The University of Chicago has a rich history of scholarship in China and Asia, and the Center in Beijing has greatly contributed to research collaboration, educational opportunities, mutual engagement and societal impact in this vital region,” said President Robert J. Zimmer. “Since its opening, the center has built upon the University’s rich legacy of research and educational collaborations, making it an intellectual destination for scholars across the world.”

### **Deepening research partnerships**

The Center in Beijing has served as a gathering place for UChicago faculty and their colleagues in East Asia, as well as for prospective, incoming, and current students, alumni, and members of the public. The University’s relationships with local peer institutions have led to field-defining research in, with and about China, as well as strong relationships between researchers. In addition, public lectures and artistic exhibitions at the center have invited the Beijing community to participate in the University’s tradition of rigorous academic inquiry.

The Center in Beijing is also home to several long-running and new initiatives, including the Young Du Chung Chin Beijing: East Asian Civilizations undergraduate study abroad program, as well as several major initiatives focused on research collaboration on topics related to China. For example, in 2018, the Becker Friedman Institute for Economics at the University of Chicago launched its new BFI-China initiative, which works in partnership with Chinese researchers and research institutions to develop new insights on the critical economic issues facing Chinese policymakers. The University also recently signed a memorandum of understanding establishing an innovative collaboration between University of Chicago and Tsinghua University scholars, who will conduct research across a range of economic issues.

**_“Since its opening, the center has built upon the University’s rich legacy of research and educational collaborations, making it an intellectual destination for scholars across the world.”_**  
—President Robert J. Zimmer

Other major faculty-led collaborations include a partnership between the Pritzker School of Medicine and the Peking Union Medical College and Hospital, as well as a collaboration between the School of Social Service Administration, Hong Kong Polytechnic University and Peking University focused on training new social workers in China.

The Center in Beijing is a cornerstone for the University’s global presence, which extends to hundreds of programs and initiatives in more than 40 countries on all seven continents. Since the Center in Beijing opened in 2010, the University opened the Center in Delhi in 2014 and the Hong Kong Jockey Club University of Chicago Academic Complex | The University of Chicago Francis and Rose Yuen Campus in Hong Kong in 2018. Chicago Booth broadened its presence in Europe with a new state-of-the-art campus in London in 2020, and the University is currently expanding its Center in Paris, which has experienced tremendous growth since opening in 2003.

The Center in Beijing works closely to support the University community across Asia, along with the Center in Delhi and the Hong Kong Jockey Club University of Chicago Academic Complex | The University of Chicago Francis and Rose Yuen Campus in Hong Kong, which serves as a regional hub for research and education in East Asia.

# Jacobs University becomes Constructor University

[Business Announcement](link_5)
Jacobs University Bremen gGmbH

[Facebook](link_0)[X](link_0)[LinkedIn](link_0)[WeChat](link_0)[Bluesky](link_0)[Message](link_0)[WhatsApp](link_0)[Email](link_0)

[![Image 5: Jacobs University becomes Constructor University](link_6)](https://www.eurekalert.org/multimedia/966980 [link_7])

**image:The private university in Bremen, Germany has announced its new name and brand: Constructor University.**[view more](link_7)

Credit: Constructor University

Constructor is inspired by core aspects of a learning environment, and fitted to a community of young aspiring scientists and future leaders – as it has always existed on the university campus in Bremen. With “construction” being a process of creating complex objects and ideas across all disciplines, it is understood as an essential skill which enables the next generation to solve the challenges of its times.

The Constructor framework can be applied across many fields, from physics to computing, life science, philosophy, education, architecture, and arts. Akin to this spirit, Constructor University will continue to offer its wide range of programs, including hybrid and digital formats, as well as continuously developing new ones. Values, such as diversity, tolerance and a sense of community continue to be essential on campus. A culture rooted in leadership and the entrepreneurial spirit, and skills, such as critical and creative thinking and problem solving, remain an important part of the university’s approach.

“We will take this university – a special place for so many – even further than it has come in the past twenty years. Science and education are ever evolving, and so are universities. We are proud to have such a strong foundation to build upon, when building the unique pathway for a future as Constructor University,” said Fabio Pammolli, President of the University

Dr. Serg Bell, Founder and Chairman of Constructor group, Chief Research Officer of Acronis and Chairman of the Board of Governors of Constructor University, signed the contract to become the [majority shareholder of the private university](link_8) in Bremen-Nord just last year. Today, just over one year later, the university received a new name and a new brand, which marks a pivotal transition in the institution’s path along with deeper commitment on behalf of the majority shareholder. With the university’s excellent international reputation in mind, Bell decided to start the process sooner rather than later, in order to uphold and strengthen it in the long run.

The rebranding is based on the rapid growth of the former Schaffhausen Institute of Technology (SIT), founded by Dr. Serg Bell in 2019. As it has become a global organization with locations in more than 15 countries and a global network, this should be reflected in a new and broader brand name: Constructor group. Constructor is a global institution, dedicated to promoting science, education, and cutting-edge technology. Related entities such as Alemira by Constructor, Rolos by Constructor, Constructor Learning and Constructor Capital aim to not only cover the entire learning lifecycle but also to break ground on next-generation research capacities, and platforms.

As a part of this Constructor ecosystem, Constructor University faculty and students will benefit from partnerships with high-ranked universities worldwide, such as Carnegie Mellon University, the University of Geneva, and the National University of Singapore's School of Computing, not to mention the variety of technology and innovation-driven companies.

Since its involvement in the ecosystem, the university has entered partnerships with [Anisoprint](link_9), known for its 3D printing systems, [ChemDiv](link_10), a global leader for drug discovery solutions, and [JetBrains](link_11), a cutting-edge software engineering vendor- giving students the opportunity to network with experts and dive into practical experiences on-site. Another attractive novelty are the [online and hybrid study programs](link_12) in Computer and Data Science, Software Engineering and Entrepreneurship that were just developed this year. Constructor University is currently hosting more students than ever before with 1.800 enrollments, and for them, there are many more exciting developments on the horizon.

**About Constructor University:**  
[An international community, vibrant and diverse.](https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/973037)Offering academic excellence, ensuring the highest standards in research and teaching. Empowering students to solve the world’s pressing challenges through knowledge and science: Constructor University is a top-ranked, English-speaking, private university. Founded in 2001, it provides a wide range of 25+ academic programs and PhD. The Constructor ecosystem, comprises the university, located in Bremen, Germany and an institute in Schaffhausen, Switzerland.  
 Over 1.800 students from more than 110 nations on campus benefit from a unique interdisciplinary, foundational theoretical and practical education. Enriched with a buzzing entrepreneurial culture that prepares young professionals to thrive in the job market. With 6.000+ alumni worldwide our community keeps growing – with our highest cohort ever registered in 2022.  
 he research-centric faculty projects are funded by the German Research Foundation and the European Union's Framework Program for Research and Innovation as well as by globally leading companies.  
 Constructor University benefits from partnerships with high-ranked universities such as Carnegie Mellon, the University of Geneva or the National University of Singapore School of Computing, and technology companies such as Anisoprint, JetBrains and ChemDiv.

The Constructor ecosystem is a global institution dedicated to addressing the main challenges of the world through science, education, and technology. Apart from the University, the ecosystem relies on several for-profit entities that provide technology infrastructures and solutions, life-long education programs, consulting services, and funding: Alemira by Constructor, Rolos by Constructor, Constructor Learning and Constructor Capital.

Queen’s University

Kingston, Canada

Solving the world’s greatest challengesQueen’s is a research-intense university celebrated for academic excellence and outstanding student experience. It consistently ranks among Canada’s best and is a leader in social and sustainable impact, with notable strengths in cancer research, materials science, AI and supercomputing, sustainable technologies, art conservation, and physics—highlighted by a 2015 Nobel Prize.Since 2019, Queen’s has ranked in the global top 10 of the Times Higher Education Impact Rankings and is in the top 200 of the QS World University Rankings (2025).Student experienceQueen’s offers over 170 disciplines of study across 53 departments, including health sciences, engineering, business, arts and humanities, and more. With an 89% graduation rate—the highest in Canada—over 95% of Queen's graduates find employment within six months of completing their studies, and all graduates join its active alumni network of 150,000 people across 119 countries.Campus and communityEstablished in 1841 and located in Kingston, Ontario, a vibrant waterfront city known for its limestone architecture, Queen's campus is a blend of historic buildings and modern facilities. Not far from major Canadian cities like Toronto and Montreal, Queen’s is home to over 31,000 undergraduate and graduate students and more than 5,000 faculty and staff from over 100 countries. World-class research facilitiesQueen’s hosts 22 specialized research centres and institutes where scholars collaborate with experts from around the world to address complex local and global issues. This dynamic academic ecosystem is complemented by access to state-of-the-art cultural and research facilities, including: Arthur B. McDonald Canadian Astroparticle Physics Research Institute Named after its 2015 Nobel Prize in Physics laureate, this institute and its researchers explore cosmic mysteries, including dark matter and neutrino science, working at SNOLAB, the world’s deepest clean laboratory. Queen’s University Biological StationThis is Canada’s largest inland field station, spanning 3,400 hectares dedicated to research and teaching while conserving local terrestrial and aquatic environments to enhance our understanding of biodiversity. Agnes Etherington Art CentreThis research-intensive, on-campus art centre houses over 17,000 works in its collections, including Canada’s largest public collection of Rembrandt pieces. Isabel Bader Centre for the Performing ArtsThis premier performing arts venue features research and performance spaces for music, theatre, and dance, serving as a hub for artistic collaboration and cultural events in Kingston. Centre for Advanced Computing (CAC)As a leading data centre and cognitive analytics hub, the CAC provides access to flexible high-performance compute resources and modern data analytics solutions. It is home to world leading experts in AI and exascale computing, who have built some of the world’s largest supercomputers.

Friedrich Schiller University Jena

Jena, Germany

Since its foundation in 1558, the University of Jena has shaped literary epochs, established new fields of research, inspired industries, and survived political assimilation. Today, Friedrich Schiller University attracts students and researchers from all over the world. Students number around 18,000 in total, while over 2.600 students are international, representing more than 100 countries. University of Jena offers support and supervision from the beginning providing an excellent student-staff ratio. Furthermore, the promotion of early-stage researchers is of central importance. Friedrich Schiller University is operating a “House for Young Researchers” which provides a Welcome and Service Desk. With its 10 faculties, the University of Jena covers the broad academic canon from the natural and life sciences (including human medicine) to the social sciences and humanities. It pools its research areas into three main themes “Light, Life, Liberty” representing the proven strengths of Jena University. “Light” integrates material and energy research combining these with cutting-edge research in optics and photonics. “Life” connects microbiology and biodiversity, as well as research into ageing and sepsis. “Liberty” combines research on enlightenment and romanticism with contemporary research in the social sciences, history, and Eastern Europe. Additionally, Jena University maintains a dense network of international collaboration with more than 500 partners worldwide and at the same time has contributed to a unique culture of close cooperation regionally with university and non-university research institutions, the University Hospital, and high-tech industry. University of Jena is among the top 10 start-up universities in Germany reflecting its mission of knowledge and technology transfer.
